instruction: Candid medium shot of two women outdoors. On the left, the bride in the light green saree (R1) stands in profile, smiling warmly. On the right, the woman in the red and dark blue outfit (R5) smiles as she gently lifts the bride's chin with her hand. Both have their hair decorated with white flowers. The background consists of soft, out-of-focus green foliage under bright, natural daylight.

The scene is outdoors with soft green foliage in bright natural daylight
